overview: The Council requested updates on traffic mitigation near Ball Square and Fulton Spring Road and reviewed signage and redevelopment issues at the Lawrence Memorial Hospital site. The Council also addressed water and sewer fee accounting, referred personnel ordinance changes to committee, and confirmed an appointment to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: Ball Square Traffic Mitigation Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update on coordination with the City of Somerville regarding traffic and parking impacts from a proposed marijuana dispensary in Ball Square.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Site Update
items.summary: Approved a request for an update from Hallmark Health regarding the Lawrence Memorial Hospital site, including ADA access, neighborhood mitigation, and the status of the Malden Hospital site.

items.title: Fulton Spring Road Traffic Safety
items.summary: Approved a request for a progress report on traffic safety recommendations for Fulton Spring Road, including limited access signage and police enforcement data.

items.title: Speed Feedback Signage and Road Markings
items.summary: Discussed the inadvertent installation of speed feedback signs in incorrect locations near Lawrence Memorial Hospital and requested painted delineation for new speed humps.

items.title: Water and Sewer Base Fee Accounting
items.summary: Approved a request for a financial breakdown of water and sewer base fee collections and requested an update on funds collected via tax bill donation checkboxes.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Referred proposed personnel ordinance amendments creating the positions of Director of Economic Development and Director of Diversity and Human Resources to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: CPC Appointment: Steven Passini
items.summary: Confirmed the appointment of Steven Passini to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: Elderly and Housing Affairs Report
items.summary: Received a report from the subcommittee regarding progress on a housing stability task force ordinance and the implementation of a local eviction moratorium.

items.title: Public Participation on Tax Discount Program
items.summary: Heard public comment regarding a proposed tax payment discount program and the status of promised free parking for senior citizens.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Condolences
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes and adjourned in memory of Faye Gertrude Snow, former first lady of Medford.
